terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: The short version of our Terms of Use.
terms.s1Body: You must be 18 or older. By using the app you agree to these terms and our Privacy Policy.
terms.s2Body: Chosen gives you educational tools, plans and AI coaching. It is not financial, tax, investment or legal advice. Results vary and are not guaranteed: earnings examples are illustrations from public sources, not promises.
terms.s3Body: Spinning the machine is free and only picks a side-hustle idea for you. Nothing is bet or wagered, and there is no prize, money or credit to win.
terms.s4Body: Pro and Elite renew automatically until you cancel in your Apple ID settings, at least 24 hours before the current period ends. A free trial becomes a paid subscription unless you cancel before it ends. You always see the price before you buy.
terms.s5Body: Fast Pivot and message packs are used up when you use them. Refunds are handled by Apple.
terms.s6Body: The coach is an AI (Claude by Anthropic). It can make mistakes, so check important decisions yourself. Don't send passwords, bank details or other people's personal data.
terms.s7Body: Your check-ins, answers and messages stay yours. You can export or delete them at any time in Profile. We may close accounts that abuse the service.
terms.full: Read the full Terms of Use

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: The short version of our Privacy Policy.
privacy.s1Body: Your sign-in (Apple or Google: email and, if you share it, your name), your answers, your hustle and roadmap progress, check-ins (including the amounts you enter and screenshots you attach), coach messages, purchases (never card details) and, if you allow notifications, your push token.
privacy.s2Body: To run the app and your plan; for the AI coach, only if you turn on AI data sharing; to improve the app, only if you turn on analytics; and to send the notifications you switched on.
privacy.s3Body: Supabase (database and files, EU – Frankfurt), Anthropic (Claude AI, USA, only with your AI consent; your data isn't used to train their models), RevenueCat (purchases), PostHog (analytics, EU, only with your consent), Apple and Google (sign-in, payments, notifications) and Expo (notification delivery).
privacy.s4Body: With your consent we record which screens and main buttons you use, and may record screen sessions to find confusing screens. Every text field and image is hidden in recordings. No money amounts, no location. You can turn this off any time in Profile.
privacy.s5Body: You can see, export, correct and delete your data. Export: Profile → Download my data. Delete: Profile → Delete account (this removes everything, including your coach history). Questions: {{email}}.
privacy.s6Body: Until you delete your account. Purchase records are kept by Apple and RevenueCat as the law requires.
privacy.s7Body: We never sell your data or use it for advertising, and we don't track you across other apps or websites.

ai.title: The AI coach and your data
ai.intro: How the AI coach uses your data.
ai.s1Body: When AI data sharing is on: your answers to the setup questions, your hustle and roadmap progress, your check-ins (with any screenshots you attach) and your messages to the coach.
ai.s2Body: Anthropic's Claude models, through their API. Anthropic doesn't use API data to train its models.
ai.s3Body: The coach is software, not a person, and not a financial adviser. It can be wrong. Double-check anything important.
ai.s4Body: Profile → AI coach data sharing. When it is off, nothing is sent to Anthropic: the coach chat, check-in analysis and roadmap personalization stop, and the rest of the app keeps working.

affiliate.s2Body: Commissions never decide which tools we recommend, and free options are listed whenever they exist. You never have to use a linked tool.
